summary: Tested the client feedback loop and the certificate journey summary end to end. Backend: 13 of 14 new pytest tests pass (tests/test_coaching_feedback.py). Working: request -> pending -> certificate 409 -> skip_feedback_check 200, withdraw, all validation (422/400/403), submit end_of_plan clears pending, coach/admin lists and summaries, public testimonials (allow_public only, first name only), feedback_id 400 when not allowed, stats/summary/quote on the certificate (review_text = testimonial, weight_change_kg null) and the PDF (%PDF). One failure: portal-view feedback.pending_request stays true after the client has answered. Frontend: member, coach and admin flows all work. Two bugs found: (1) sonner toasts never showed anywhere in the app because no sonner <Toaster/> was mounted. I fixed this in App.js. (2) /coaching testimonials are not visible to logged-out visitors, because the page is a sign-in gate when logged out. They only render for logged-in users.

minor.issue: feedback.pending_request = bool(feedback_requested_at) and does not check whether an end_of_plan answer exists since then. GET /coach/clients/{id}/feedback and /my/feedback do check this. After the client answers, the coach 'View client's portal' -> Feedback page keeps showing the 'Your coach has asked for end-of-plan feedback' banner and labels the form 'End-of-plan feedback'. Fix: reuse the same pending calculation as coach_client_feedback (coaching_plans_routes.py ~line 446).
A testimonial that is only whitespace (e.g. ' ') passes the $ne '' filter. Strip the testimonial on submit.

ui_bugs.issue: No sonner <Toaster/> was mounted (only the shadcn radix Toaster), so every toast.* from 'sonner' was silently dropped: PortalFeedback, MyCoaching, PhotosAndCertificates, WeighInPanel, PortalSections. The member saw no 'Please give an overall star rating' error and no success toast. FIXED by the testing agent: added <SonnerToaster richColors position='top-right'/> in App.js. Verified the error toast now shows.

integration_issues.issue: Logged-out visitors get the 'SIGN IN TO REQUEST COACHING' gate, so <Testimonials/> never renders for the public, even though the API returns the Alex quote. It renders correctly when logged in. The 'public coaching page' permission therefore does not reach anyone outside an account. Render <Testimonials/> on the logged-out gate view too.

issues: The cert-quote-source options look the same when a client has several quotes on the same day (e.g. 'Client's own words · 12 Nov · 5★' twice). Add a short snippet of the quote to each option label.
Read-only is enforced only by opacity and pointer-events:none, so keyboard users can still tab in and submit (the backend would reject it with 403). Prefer a <fieldset disabled>.

action_items: Fix the portal-view feedback.pending_request calculation so it matches /coach/clients/{id}/feedback: pending only while no end_of_plan feedback exists since feedback_requested_at.
Show the Testimonials section on /coaching for logged-out visitors (the sign-in gate view).
Keep the sonner Toaster mount in App.js (added by the testing agent) and mirror it to the Helixaris build if that build is separate.
Optional: strip testimonial/went_well/improve on submit; add a quote snippet to the cert-quote-source option labels.
critical_code_review_comments: coaching_plans_routes.coach_portal_view duplicates the pending logic incorrectly. Extract a shared _is_pending(client) helper in coaching_feedback_routes and use it in all three places, plus the certificate 409 check.
submit_feedback has no dedupe or rate limit, so a member can spam feedback and skew NPS and averages.
admin_feedback loads up to 1000 docs and builds the summary in Python. Fine for now, but it should be paginated or aggregated later.
Two notification systems are in use (shadcn useToast and sonner). Standardise on one.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all flows pass except public logged-out testimonials; the toast bug was fixed)

seed_data_creation: None kept. The test feedback, certificates and TEST_ user from pytest were deleted by id in teardown. The UI-created feedback d8dc8cc0... and certificate dc8466a1... were deleted by id via Mongo; the certificate's storage object may remain. Side effect: the demo client's feedback_requested_at is now unset because the request was withdrawn. The originally answered request is no longer recorded, but the original Alex feedback and its certificates are intact.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_coaching_feedback.py -v -p no:randomly. The tests must run in order (class state). The teardown withdraws the feedback request. For the frontend, set localStorage ghp_token plus sessionStorage ghp_age_verified='true' and ghp_site_unlocked='1'. Coach panels use the shadcn toast (li[role=status]). The member portal uses sonner ([data-sonner-toast]), which now works. Logged-out /coaching shows a sign-in gate. The calendar entry testid is cal-entry-<id>.
rca of the issue: Portal-view pending: coaching_plans_routes.py sets 'pending_request': bool(client.get('feedback_requested_at')). Repro: request feedback -> member submits -> GET /coach/clients/{id}/portal-view shows feedback.pending_request true, while /coach/clients/{id}/feedback shows false. Toasts: App.js imported only ./components/ui/toaster (radix), while the new pages call toast from 'sonner'.
